name: Backup Failures
description: Catches failed Proxmox VE backups (vzdump, including jobs to Proxmox Backup Server), borg runs that end with an error (only with --show-rc), and common restic failures (wrong password, repository not found or locked). Tools that do not write to syslog or Docker logs, such as Duplicati, are not covered.
match_pattern: Backup of VM \d+ failed|Backup job finished with errors|terminating with (?:error|signal|abnormal) status, rc \d+|Fatal: (?:wrong password or no key found|unable to open (?:config file|repository)|unable to create lock in backend)
